message.content:
Make Nxeon email the PDF invoice to customers on (a) their initial order and (b) each renewal. The PDF generator + mailer auto-attach already exist; the two hook points just don't fire. Money-path work — additive and best-effort, never break an order/renewal.

Work ONLY in worktree **/opt/nxeon-wt-cardsave/** (node_modules + .env symlinked to prod). It already contains committed billing changes (card-saving + renewal-reminder) — BUILD ON TOP, do not revert them. Absolute paths under that dir; never edit /opt/nxeon. `cd /opt/nxeon-wt-cardsave` for shell. Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and fix ALL type errors. Do NOT build the app, deploy, restart, or run prisma migrate/generate/db push. No schema change needed.

VERIFIED CONTEXT:
- `lib/mailer.ts`: `sendMail(opts)` auto-attaches the invoice PDF (via `renderInvoicePDF`) WHEN `opts.invoiceId` is set AND the template ∈ `INVOICE_ATTACH_TEMPLATES = {"receipt","invoice_new","renewal_reminder"}`. So: pass `invoiceId` + one of those templates ⇒ the customer gets the PDF attached.
- `lib/email-templates.ts`: `emails.receipt(...)` (template `"receipt"`, subject "Payment received — $amount") and `emails.invoiceNew(...)` (template `"invoice_new"`). Read both to see their exact args.
- `lib/order.ts` `placeOrder(...)`: creates the order `Invoice` (status PAID) inside a transaction (~line 812, `tx.invoice.create(...)`) but NEVER emails it — this is why customers currently get no invoice. `placeOrder` is the SHARED success point for BOTH the wallet path and the card/Stripe fulfilment path, and it has the `user`. It returns the server id.
- `worker/billing.ts`: a renewal creates its invoice (~line 561 `tx.invoice.create(...)`) and sends a receipt via the local `mail(to,userId,tpl,kind)` helper (~line 199 → `sendMail`), but that helper is NOT currently passing `invoiceId`, so the renewal receipt has NO PDF.
- Existing "Payment received" emails exist for wallet top-ups — so for the ORDER invoice, prefer `emails.invoiceNew` (a distinct "here's your invoice" message) over `emails.receipt`, to avoid the customer getting two near-identical "Payment received — $X" emails. Use whichever the templates support cleanly; explain your choice.

DO THIS:
1. ORDER INVOICE EMAIL (`lib/order.ts` placeOrder):
   - Capture the created order invoice's `id` (and number/amount if the template needs them) from the `tx.invoice.create(...)`.
   - AFTER the transaction commits successfully (so a rolled-back order emails nothing), send the invoice to `user.email` using `emails.invoiceNew(...)` with `sendMail({... invoiceId: <that id>, template stays "invoice_new", kind: "invoice", userId: user.id })` so the PDF attaches. If `emails.invoiceNew` needs fields you don't have, build them from the invoice you just created.
   - Wrap in try/catch so a mail failure can NEVER affect the placed order (the money already moved). Fire exactly once per order (it's after the single commit).
   - This must cover both wallet-paid and card-paid orders — since both go through `placeOrder`, one call here does both. Confirm placeOrder isn't ALSO reached by a path that already emails an invoice (avoid duplicates); if a topup/credit receipt is separate, that's fine — the ORDER invoice is a different document.
2. RENEWAL INVOICE EMAIL (`worker/billing.ts`):
   - Where a renewal SUCCEEDS and creates its invoice, pass that invoice's `id` as `invoiceId` to the receipt send (the `mail()` helper → `sendMail`) so the renewal receipt attaches the PDF. Either extend the `mail()` helper to accept/forward an optional `invoiceId`, or call `sendMail` directly for the renewal receipt with `invoiceId` + `kind:"receipt"` (template "receipt" is in the attach set). Keep it best-effort; exactly one receipt per renewal. Do NOT change the dunning/failure emails.
3. Verify no double invoice email per order and per renewal; verify the templates used are in `INVOICE_ATTACH_TEMPLATES` so the PDF actually attaches.

CONSTRAINTS: additive + best-effort (never break placeOrder or billingSweep); reuse `emails.invoiceNew`/`emails.receipt` + the mailer's auto-attach; correct NotifyKind (`invoice`/`receipt`, both ACCOUNT-tier — not marketing); tsc clean; no build/deploy/db/schema.

RETURN (final text = data for me, no preamble): (1) files changed, 1 line each; (2) the exact order hook (where in placeOrder, post-commit) + which template/kind + how you got the invoice id; (3) the renewal hook + how invoiceId now flows to the receipt; (4) how you confirmed no duplicate invoice emails; (5) how to test end-to-end that a customer receives the PDF on order and on renewal (incl. checking the emailed attachment); (6) risks. Branch wt-cardsave, commit nothing (I'll commit).

## Report

**(1) Files changed**
- `lib/order.ts` — capture the order `Invoice` from the in-tx `invoice.create`, then post-commit email it via `emails.invoiceNew` + `sendMail({invoiceId,...})` so the PDF attaches; added `invoiceBranding`/`formatInvoiceNumber` imports.
- `worker/billing.ts` — extended the `mail()` helper with an optional `invoiceId`; capture the renewal `Invoice` in `commitRenewal` and email it (`emails.invoiceNew`, `kind:"invoice"`, `invoiceId`) on the single "renewed" success exit.

**(2) Order hook** — In `placeOrder`, after the `db.$transaction` commits and after the deploy-funnel bookkeeping, immediately before `return server.id`. Invoice id: I changed `tx.invoice.create(...)` to `const createdInvoice = await tx.invoice.create(...)` and copy `{id, number, amountCents, description:lineDesc}` into an outer `orderInvoice` var (assigned inside the `if (!freeRequested)` block, so free admin grants stay null and email nothing). Template/kind: `emails.invoiceNew` → template `"invoice_new"` (∈ attach set), `kind:"invoice"` (ACCOUNT tier). `invoiceId: createdInvoice.id` triggers the mailer auto-attach. Covers wallet + card orders because both paths (`lib/actions.ts`, `lib/fulfil-checkout.ts`) converge on this one `placeOrder`.

**(3) Renewal hook** — In `commitRenewal` (the single place a VPS/game renewal is granted; reached by both the wallet-only and card paths). Captured the created invoice into an outer `renewedInvoice` var and, right before `return "renewed"`, call `mail(email, userId, emails.invoiceNew({...}), "invoice", renewedInvoice.id)`. The `invoiceId` now flows: `mail()` gained an `invoiceId?` param forwarded straight into `sendMail`, and template `"invoice_new"` is in `INVOICE_ATTACH_TEMPLATES`, so the PDF attaches. Fires exactly once per successful renewal (CAS-guarded; `AlreadyRenewedError`/`InsufficientBalanceError` roll back before assignment).

**(4) No duplicates** — Order: `placeOrder`'s only `invoice.create` is the one I hooked; the sole other order-path email is `lib/stripe.ts`'s wallet/purchase-leg **receipt** (a distinct "Payment received" document that explicitly issues no order invoice — its own comment says "the order does"). Renewal: the only pre-existing success email is the card-leg `paymentReceipt` (tied to the card capture, template `payment_receipt`, not in the attach set); the wallet-only renewal previously sent nothing. I deliberately used `invoiceNew` (subject "Invoice #… — $… due"), **not** `receipt`, precisely so a card renewal isn't sent a second near-identical "Payment received — $X" alongside its card-charge receipt — mirroring the order-path split. Both new emails sit on single post-commit exits, so one per order and one per renewal. Dunning/failure emails untouched.

**(5) End-to-end test**
- Order: place a VPS order (wallet-funded and, separately, card/Stripe-funded). The customer's inbox gets an "Invoice #NX-00042 — $X due" email with a PDF attachment; admin Email Logs shows a `SENT` row, template `invoice_new`, kind `invoice`. Open the attachment — it's the itemised invoice PDF for that order. Card orders additionally get the pre-existing payment receipt (no attachment) — expected, distinct.
- Renewal: set a paid server's `expiresAt` in the past with wallet balance covering it (and separately a card-on-file case) and let the billing sweep run. Customer gets an "Invoice #… — $…" email with the renewal PDF attached; Email Logs shows template `invoice_new`, kind `invoice`. A rolled-back/`already`-renewed sweep sends nothing.
- Attachment check: `INVOICE_ATTACH_TEMPLATES` includes `invoice_new` and both sends pass `invoiceId`, so `lib/mailer.ts` `invoiceAttachment()` renders + attaches the PDF. Confirm the file opens and matches the invoice number/amount.

**(6) Risks**
- Best-effort only: both sends are wrapped so a mail/branding failure can never break an order or a renewal (money already moved). Verified.
- Notification prefs: `kind:"invoice"` is ACCOUNT-tier and therefore email-suppressible — a customer who turned account email off won't get the PDF. This is the intended central policy (same as receipts), not a bug.
- Card renewals now send two emails (card-charge receipt + invoice) and card orders likewise (payment receipt + invoice) — intentional and non-duplicative, but it is one more message than before.
- `commitRenewal` serves both VPS and game renewals, so game renewals now also get an invoice email (desirable).
- No schema/build/deploy/migrate performed; `npx tsc --noEmit` passes clean. Nothing committed — branch `wt-cardsave`, ready for you to commit.
